item.title: [breach] Hackers access Booking.com user data, company secures systems
item.description: Hackers accessed some Booking.com user data, including names, emails, phone numbers, and booking details. The issue is now contained. Booking.com warned that hackers may have accessed customer data linked to travel reservations. Exposed details could include names, email addresses, phone numbers, and information shared with accommodations. Booking.com is one of the world&#8217;s leading online travel agencies [&#8230;]
